summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K with a report of voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders on August 7, 2026. All 10 director nominees were elected, with votes for ranging from 76.02% to 97.60%. KPMG LLP was appointed as auditors with 94.94% votes for. This is a routine disclosure of meeting outcomes, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic action, or management change is involved. The filing merely reflects standard corporate governance procedures and requires no further action or special monitoring.
